requirement.statement: Codument SHALL keep spec-declared validation rules, canonical examples, and CLI validator behavior consistent, and SHALL implement deterministic rules in the CLI with AI-friendly findings output.

case.given: 一个 mission.xml 的 TaskGroup 或 Task 带有 status 属性
case.then: 系统 SHALL accept only NOT_STARTED, ACTIVE, DONE, BLOCKED, ABANDONED, SUPERSED
case.and: 系统 SHALL report any other value as an error with a rule id, file, and position

case.given: 一个 mission.xml 的 Hook 带有 on 属性
case.then: 系统 SHALL accept track:before|after, phase:before|after, task:before|after, and mission:after-node

case.given: 一个 mission.xml 声明 <Schedule><Dag for>
case.then: 系统 SHALL require the Dag target to declare cdt:child-mode="dag"
case.and: 系统 SHALL require Node id and After ref to reference direct children of that layer

case.given: 一个 mission.xml 的节点带 cdt:TrackLink
case.then: 系统 SHALL error when TrackLink is attached to a TaskGroup instead of a leaf Task

case.given: 一个 mission.xml 包含 cdt:MissionReconcile
case.then: 系统 SHALL validate max-tracks is a positive integer and on-limit/on-drift use documented values

case.given: decisions.xnl 中存在 status="pending" 的决策记录
case.when: 用户运行 codument decisions validate
case.then: 系统 SHALL report a warning, not an error, and SHALL NOT fail the command

case.given: 一个 durable_candidate=true 的决策在归档时仍未 resolve
case.then: 系统 SHALL report an error and block promotion
系统 SHALL require a mermaid representation that declares state definitions
系统 SHALL require a ctrl|rule|dataflow pseudo slot in addition to the four IO types blocks
系统 SHALL require a command|message marker
系统 SHALL require a rule pseudo or a behavior:// reference

case.given: 一个 cdt:GapLoop 的 on-exhausted 不是 block|continue|fail
case.then: 系统 SHALL report an error

case.given: 一个 cdt:AttractorCheck 的 use 引用不存在的 profile
case.then: 系统 SHALL report an error that names the profile and lists available profiles

case.given: 任何校验命令产生 findings
case.then: 系统 SHALL emit machine-readable findings with rule id, file, line/position, severity, and message

case.given: 任何校验命令产生 findings
case.when: 用户以默认 human 输出调用
case.then: 系统 SHALL print a readable summary with fix hints per error

case.given: track-xml-spec 的 canonical §4/§5 组合示例
case.when: 系统运行 codument validate 于该示例 fixture
case.then: 系统 SHALL pass with no errors

case.given: README-cn.md 与 docs/codument-xml-configs.md 描述当前格式
case.when: 审查者或回归测试检查这些文档
case.then: 系统 SHALL NOT reference plan.xml, spec_deltas, feature.json, or TODO/IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED as current format
